blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu—Some water refilling stations in Minglanilla have agreed to help local households cope with El Niño by saving their wastewater. The Municipal Government organized the owners of these water refilling stations, which will serve as official water stations in the barangays. “After reverse osmosis in the water refilling stations, only about 40 percent becomes potable water and sold, while 60 percent is normally thrown away,” Acting Minglanilla Mayor Lheslen Abella Enad said in a Facebook post on Friday, November 13.
